routing_description: Accessory behavior, charging observations and general electrical symptoms beyond starting.
planner_instructions: Gather charging, accessory and electrical symptom observations without assuming they describe a battery starting problem. Identify which observations are reported symptoms and which are measurements. Preserve timestamps and units when comparing readings. The battery pack is separate; request its coverage later if starting evidence becomes relevant. Missing electrical observations must remain an explicit gap. Do not infer a failed electrical component from a warning alone.
